nodes.name: discovery.ts
nodes.summary: Skill discovery service that pulls remote skill registries: fetches an index.json from a configured URL, validates every entry against path-traversal attacks, and downloads each skill's file set into the global cache with bounded concurrency.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect service built with Layer.effect and Context.Service; safePath() rejects resolved targets that escape the cache base via path.relative prefix checks.

nodes.name: download
nodes.summary: Downloads a single skill file over HTTP and writes it to disk, skipping files that already exist and logging-and-swallowing download failures so one bad file does not abort the pull.

nodes.name: pull
nodes.summary: Fetches and validates a remote skill index, filters entries missing SKILL.md, blocks path traversal in skill names and file paths, then concurrently downloads all skill files and returns the cache directories that ended up with a SKILL.md.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for skill discovery, exposing the pull(url) operation to consumers via the @opencode/SkillDiscovery tag.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The skill registry: discovers SKILL.md files from config directories, external ~/.claude and ~/.agents dirs, configured extra paths, and remote URLs; validates frontmatter with zod (emitting warnings rather than rejecting), maintains a zvec embedding index for semantic skill matching, and publishes skill.loaded/unloaded/warning bus events.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-instance state via InstanceState.make; the zvec index must open before the manifest is read or a dimension migration can wipe valid entries. Built-in skills register before disk discovery so user skills can override them.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Parses one SKILL.md, validates its frontmatter against the zod schema (name length, description, allowed-tools), collects non-fatal warnings (missing description, name/folder mismatch, duplicates) as skill.warning events, and registers the skill in the registry state.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Globs a root directory for SKILL.md matches and accumulates them (plus their parent dirs) into the shared scan state, dying on errors for config dirs but degrading to an empty result for scoped external dirs.

nodes.name: discoverSkills
nodes.summary: Enumerates all skill source locations: global and project-external dirs (~/.claude, ~/.agents unless disabled by flags), opencode config directories, extra configured paths (with ~ expansion), and remotely pulled URL directories.

nodes.name: matchBySemantics
nodes.summary: Embeds the user message and searches the zvec index for related skills, filtering by already-loaded set, permission deny rules, and a similarity threshold; embedding failures degrade to zero matches instead of failing the prompt build.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Formats the available-skills list for the model: verbose mode emits an XML <available_skills> block with name/description/location, non-verbose emits a markdown bullet list.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for the Skill registry, exposing get/all/allIncludingInvalid/dirs/available/markLoaded/matchBySemantics to the rest of the app.

nodes.name: customize-opencode.md
nodes.summary: Body of the built-in customize-opencode skill: a 13-section reference for opencode's own configuration surface (opencode.json fields, agents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, permissions, escape hatches) so the model edits config with real schemas instead of guesses. Imported as text in skill/index.ts and registered behind the OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CUSTOMIZE_SKILL flag.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Snapshot service that shadows the working tree in a private bare git directory (keyed by project id and worktree hash) to provide undo/revert: tracks modified and untracked files, produces patches and per-file diffs via git plumbing commands, restores or reverts snapshots, and prunes snapshots older than 7 days.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs git with --git-dir/--work-tree against a snapshot dir under Global.Path.data, never touching the user's repo; a per-gitdir Semaphore map serializes concurrent snapshot operations and large files (over 2MB) are excluded from tracking.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Prunes stale snapshot state, dropping refs older than the 7-day retention window from the shadow gitdir.

nodes.name: track
nodes.summary: Stages the current working-tree state into the snapshot gitdir (modified plus untracked files, honoring ignore rules and size limits) and returns the commit hash of the new snapshot.

nodes.name: patch
nodes.summary: Returns the Patch (hash plus file list) recorded for a given snapshot hash by diffing the snapshot ref against the empty tree.

nodes.name: diffNames
nodes.summary: Produces a Patch whose file list is the set of files changed between two snapshot hashes.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Checks out a snapshot's tracked files back into the working tree, restoring the recorded state.

nodes.name: revert
nodes.summary: Applies a list of patches in reverse to undo file changes, removing added files and restoring deleted/modified content from the snapshot store.

nodes.name: diff
nodes.summary: Returns a unified text diff between the current working tree and a snapshot hash after first tracking the current state.

nodes.name: diffFull
nodes.summary: Computes per-file FileDiff records (file, patch text, additions, deletions, status) between two snapshots, batch-fetching blob contents via git cat-file --batch with a per-file git show fallback when the batch stream is truncated.
nodes.languageNotes: Parses the cat-file --batch stream manually (header, blob size, newline framing) and bails out to a slower per-file path on any truncation or header anomaly.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for the Snapshot service, exposing init/cleanup/track/patch/diffNames/restore/revert/diff/diffFull to consumers such as the edit tool and session undo flows.

nodes.name: sql.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declaration that types imports of *.sql files as string default exports, enabling migration SQL to be embedded at compile time.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Developer notes on database semantics: the lazy Client singleton leaks state across tests, Database.use falls back to the global client outside transactions, and the NotPromise generic constraint requires an as-cast on wrapper functions.

nodes.name: db.bun.ts
nodes.summary: Bun-runtime SQLite initializer: opens a bun:sqlite Database and wraps it with drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite; selected through the #db import alias under the bun/default conditions.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Creates the Bun SQLite database connection (create: true) and returns the drizzle-wrapped client.

nodes.name: db.node.ts
nodes.summary: Node-runtime SQLite initializer: opens a node:sqlite DatabaseSync and wraps it with drizzle-orm/node-sqlite; selected through the #db import alias under the node condition.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Creates the Node SQLite DatabaseSync connection and returns the drizzle-wrapped client.

nodes.name: db.ts
nodes.summary: Database module: lazy singleton SQLite client tuned with WAL/busy_timeout/foreign_keys pragmas, drizzle migrations applied from bundled or dev directories, channel-scoped database paths, and LocalContext-based use/transaction/effect wrappers that give callers ambient transaction semantics with post-commit side effects.
nodes.languageNotes: The #db subpath import switches between bun:sqlite and node:sqlite at package resolution time; transaction() propagates the tx through LocalContext so nested use() calls join the outer transaction, and queued effects run only after commit.

nodes.name: getChannelPath
nodes.summary: Computes the SQLite file path, isolating beta/other installation channels into opencode-<channel>.db so dev channels never share a database with prod.

nodes.name: migrations
nodes.summary: Reads migration directories from disk, parses each timestamped folder name into a UTC epoch, and returns the journal entries sorted chronologically for dev-mode migration.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Lazy singleton factory that opens the SQLite connection, applies performance pragmas, and runs drizzle migrations from the bundled OPENCODE_MIGRATIONS define or the dev migration directory (skippable via flag).

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the underlying SQLite client and resets the lazy singleton so the next Client() call reopens the database.

nodes.name: use
nodes.summary: Runs a synchronous callback against the ambient transaction if one exists in LocalContext, otherwise opens a fresh context bound to the global client and flushes any queued side effects afterward.

nodes.name: effect
nodes.summary: Registers a side effect to run after the current transaction commits (instance-bound); executes immediately when no transaction context is active.

nodes.name: transaction
nodes.summary: Executes a synchronous callback inside a real SQLite transaction (deferred/immediate/exclusive), joins an already-active transaction transparently, and drains queued effects only after the transaction commits.

nodes.name: json-migration.ts
nodes.summary: One-shot migration from the legacy JSON file storage tree to SQLite: scans storage/project, session, message, part, todo, permission, and share JSON files, decodes them defensively, and bulk-inserts into the drizzle tables with progress reporting and per-file error collection.
nodes.languageNotes: A single ~400-line run() orchestrator; reads are batched with Math.min caps and Promise.allSettled so corrupt JSON files are logged and skipped instead of aborting the migration.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Full migration pipeline: creates tables if needed, globs each legacy entity type in dependency order (project, session, message, part, todo, permission, share), resolves parent references, inserts rows with onConflictDoNothing, and reports progress plus collected errors.

nodes.name: schema.sql.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Drizzle column helper Timestamps (time_created with $default, time_updated with $onUpdate) mixed into table definitions across the schema.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Schema barrel re-exporting every drizzle table definition (account, account state, control account, project, session, message, part, todo, permission, session share, workspace) as the single import surface for database code.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: JSON file storage service: keyed .json documents under the storage directory with RcMap-managed file handles, TxReentrantLock read/write serialization, schema-decoded reads, in-place draft updates, and legacy storage-layout migrations that relocate pre-project-scoped data.
nodes.languageNotes: Schemas are decoded with Option-returning decoders so malformed files surface as NotFound-style errors; the MIGRATIONS array at the top runs sequentially during layer init.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads and returns a JSON document by key under a reentrant read lock, failing with NotFoundError when the file is missing.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Atomically updates a JSON document by mutating a decoded draft inside a reentrant write lock and persisting the result, creating the file if absent.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service handle for JSON storage, exposing remove/read/update/write/list to consumers.
